def choose_move(observation):
    # Defensive getters with defaults
    players = observation.get('players', [])
    self_info = next((p for p in players if p.get('id') == 0), {})
    pos = self_info.get('position', (0, 0))
    x, y = pos

    dx, dy = 0, 0
    game_type = observation.get('game_type', '')

    if game_type == 'resource_collection':
        resources = observation.get('resources', [])
        if resources:
            nearest_res = min(resources, key=lambda r: abs(r.get('position', (x, y))[0] - x) + abs(r.get('position', (x, y))[1] - y))
            res_x, res_y = nearest_res.get('position', (x, y))
            dx = 0 if res_x == x else (1 if res_x > x else -1)
            dy = 0 if res_y == y else (1 if res_y > y else -1)

    elif game_type == 'pursuit_evasion':
        agents = observation.get('agents', [])
        my_team = self_info.get('team')
        evaders = [a for a in agents if a.get('type') == 'evader' and a.get('team') != my_team]
        pursuers = [a for a in agents if a.get('type') == 'pursuer' and a.get('team') != my_team]

        if evaders:
            target = min(evaders, key=lambda a: abs(a.get('position', (x,y))[0] - x) + abs(a.get('position', (x,y))[1] - y))
            t_x, t_y = target.get('position', (x, y))
            dx = 0 if t_x == x else (1 if t_x > x else -1)
            dy = 0 if t_y == y else (1 if t_y > y else -1)
        elif pursuers:
            threat = min(pursuers, key=lambda a: abs(a.get('position', (x,y))[0] - x) + abs(a.get('position', (x,y))[1] - y))
            t_x, t_y = threat.get('position', (x, y))
            dx = 0 if t_x == x else (-1 if t_x > x else 1)
            dy = 0 if t_y == y else (-1 if t_y > y else 1)

    elif game_type == 'territory_control':
        territory = observation.get('territory', [])
        unclaimed = [t for t in territory if t.get('owner') is None]
        if unclaimed:
            target = min(unclaimed, key=lambda t: abs(t.get('position', (x,y))[0] - x) + abs(t.get('position', (x,y))[1] - y))
            t_x, t_y = target.get('position', (x, y))
            dx = 0 if t_x == x else (1 if t_x > x else -1)
            dy = 0 if t_y == y else (1 if t_y > y else -1)

    dx = max(-1, min(1, dx))
    dy = max(-1, min(1, dy))
    return [dx, dy]
